title: console boot: generate index.html's inline locale ladder from @objectstack/spec/system at build time (one spelling, not three)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Filing gate: ③ a review finding on PR #35618 (#35534): L1-a ACCEPT 7018186944 recommends this follow-up, non-blocking; the dev noted it in os-dev-report 7017703752 (out_of_scope_findings). It is a child of #35534 and is nested under it.
Reader: `domain:ui` (console boot, `ui/apps/console`). Suggested grade: p3 (a drift costs at most one extra request, never a wrong language, and CI already fails on drift).
Dedupe: `locale table index.html`, `resolveLocaleAmong`, `inline locale ladder`. Only #35534 matches.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：无。只是把页面里复制的一份语言匹配规则改成构建时自动生成。
- 为什么做：同一套语言规则现在写了三处，以后改语言列表时容易漏改一处。
- 出错会怎样：漏改时最多多发一次语言请求，不会选错语言；现有测试会报错拦住。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Facts

- PR #35618 adds `startEarlyLanguageSeed` to `ui/apps/console/index.html`. A classic inline script cannot import, so it restates `resolveLocaleAmong` and the platform tag and alias table from `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (with the platform-locales table). That is the third spelling of the ladder.
- It is safe by construction: `seedTenantLanguage` takes the parse-time request only when its `inflightGetKey` (URL, credentials, headers including `Accept-Language`) equals its own; otherwise it asks itself.
- The drift matrix in `sessionCheckBootDedup.test.tsx` runs the inline script against `pickPreferredLocale` over every tag and alias, so a drift fails CI.

## Ask

Generate the inline locale table (and, if practical, the ladder) from `@objectstack/spec/system` at build time, e.g. a Vite `transformIndexHtml` step in the console's `vite.config.ts`, so `index.html` carries no hand-written copy. Keep the drift matrix green and the one-request pin unchanged. No server change, no endpoint, no language-choice change.

⛔ Not a claim.
